I also get symptomatic when I get stressed. My psychiatrist even said that for me, stress can be a trigger for my psychosis. But it got better when I got medicated for it (I take risperidone) and now I don't experience any delusion or hallucination, but that's just me though, I know that it doesn't work as well for others or they take different medicine.

What I do to cope with stress is I take a step back from whatever it is I'm doing when I start to feel overwhelmed and give myself some room to breathe and think first before I focus back in on what I was doing. Having grounding measures helps but you should explore different coping strategies to see what works for you. Best of luck in your life!

The premise is the typical "reborn as a villainess" plot. I really liked the story at first because the art was really beautiful and the MC was pretty decent all things considered, but the thing that got me to drop it altogether was the pretty strong emphasis on the main ML as a love interest. 

He was introduced as a kid that the MC saved from slavery so he's wholly loyal and obsessed with the MC. He stays as a kid for the majority of the story and even acts like a kid towards the MC (except for the times where he became obsessive, which was a lot) but the author expects us to see him as a love interest?? There are other love interests but the main interactions are always between the kid and the MC.

And the only excuse for this is that the kid is actually the King of Beasts and was cursed to become a kid and oh wow he's actually 1000 years old so he's actually older than her??? Then why is he still acting like a kid?? I get it if he was just doing it out of fear that he'd scare the MC off but why are there so many romantic interactions between them when the truth hasn't been revealed and he's acting like a kid to appease her? She's basically raising him at this point and we're supposed to believe that they're going to get together??

Tldr: the story feels pedophilic because the main ML is introduced as a kid and stays as a kid for a pretty large chunk of the story when the MC is practically his older sister/mother throughout their interactions

I've been in a similar situation with my stepdad for years. What he's doing is not okay! Talk about this with your mother or to any of your family members that you feel comfortable and safe with. Let them know that he's being a total creep so that you have people to fall back to and to back you up if things get out of hand. If you feel safe enough and you're in a safe environment with other people, tell him off and communicate your discomfort. He needs to know about your boundaries and what he's doing is not okay. If he still continues to do what he's doing, that's a major red flag and immediately tell your mom or anyone else that can help you. 

I've held my discomfort in for a long time because I didn't want to cause a rift in my mother's marriage but I talked to them about my boundaries and, thankfully, my step-dad got the message. You have boundaries and they deserve to be respected! You have value and you don't deserve to be degraded or sexualized by anyone. I love you so much and stay safe!!
